The '''Capture of Balmorra ''' took place during [[Zakuul]] [[Prince/Legends|Princes]] [[Arcann]] and [[Thexan]]'s [[Eternal Empire raids|conquest of the Core Worlds]]. Their [[Eternal Flagship]] swiftly knocked out [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense system, allowing the twin princes to capture the world's weapon [[Factory/Legends|factories]] intact. In recognition of this momentous victory, the flagship's crew was awarded Zakuul's highest honor, the [[Medal of Eternal Valor]], by the Immortal Emperor [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]].<ref name="TOR" />
